summary: @servicetitan/kendo-theme preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package advertised as a Kendo UI CSS theme (SCSS/CSS). Its package.json declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-vV/...zip` into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, [math_init.js])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose body is a shuffled string-array with a rotator function `WV8StW` and hex-mangled identifiers (obfuscator.io shape). The bundled payload is executed automatically on `npm install` under an alternate runtime not resolvable by Node-based tooling, and its purpose is unrelated to the package's declared function of shipping CSS. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time fetch of a language runtime combined with execution of an opaque obfuscated sibling script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
